subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve visible pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared messages.ackText config, a non-terminal send-and-continue hook, or only channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: The gap is real, but every plausible fix adds a new config or plugin/channel API surface and changes visible message delivery across channels.

options.title: Approve shared ackText config
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, schema/docs, and channel delivery tests.

options.title: Add a non-terminal hook first
options.body: Expose a typed plugin/channel hook that can send interim text and then continue normal dispatch, leaving policy to plugins or channel owners.

options.title: Keep placeholders channel-specific
options.body: Handle Telegram, Slack, Discord, Feishu, and similar placeholder requests separately where each channel owns its UX and proof.

recommendation.title: Approve shared ackText config
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, schema/docs, and channel delivery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing candidate for cross-channel dispatch, acknowledgement, and config lifecycle decisions.
